notes.title: SAPPHIRE MOON-FOREVER MEMORIES -小剧场集DLC上线
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41821140/f87fbb249e739e5f378ceb383fa270872076edce.png[/img]

Hey，各位小伙伴们！大家好呀！

蔚蓝月下的回忆「小剧场集DLC」终于和大家见面啦！
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3432370/SAPPHIRE_MOONFOREVER_MEMORIES/]前往「小剧场集DLC」页面[/url]

这一路走来，真的是不容易啊！在各种颠沛流离之下，我们重要将蔚蓝月下的回忆最后的一部分更新完毕了！也算圆了一个梦！

这次的DLC包含了两个特典小剧场，分别是与小玥一同游山塘的「新春」和热热闹闹的「元宵」。

「春节特典」中你将跟随小玥的脚步，漫步在山塘街的夜景中，见证小玥身着旗袍的绝美造型，发糖发到饱。

「元宵特典」预计将在年后更新哦，在这个剧场里，你将回到第一天重新邂逅各种各样的人，与发生热热闹闹的故事。有甜蜜的爱情，有深厚的友情，还有那些让人捧腹大笑的趣事。元宵节的热闹氛围将贯穿整个剧场，最后还有喜闻乐见的包饺砸环节！

我们深知，没有大家的支持与鼓励，就没有我们的今天。每一次你们的点赞、评论和分享，都给了我们巨大的动力。是你们的热情，让我们在艰难的开发过程中，始终保持着前行的勇气和信心。真的非常感谢每一位支持我们的玩家！

最后，新的一年已经到来，我们也为大家带来了全新的游戏内容。希望大家在新的一年里，都能像在游戏里一样，拥有快乐和惊喜。再次祝愿大家新年快乐，万事如意！愿你们在蔚蓝月下，找到属于自己的那份美好与幸福。

星愿池全体成员敬上

notes.title: 小玥误会线更新
notes.notes:
各位小伙伴们：

我们已于2024/12/11下午2点20正式更新了小玥误会线。
此次更新增加了全新的剧情，3个新结局以及新CG。
因为我们在时间上花费的比较久，所以本次更新和上次更新也相差了很久，我们表示十分抱歉。
希望大家可以喜欢新的剧情，有问题也可以提出，我们会对有问题部分继续修复，感谢大家的支持。
祝愿各位小伙伴一路长虹！

星愿池敬上

notes.title: New Year's Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
After all the difficulties, we've finally finished the Rizushi thread!
It's a New Year's gift, but as we said before, it's a free update with a huge amount of content and several CGs.
This line is one of the hippest lines we've done, with all kinds of middle-grade and homage elements, so you can look for that too.
All in all we had a blast writing it, and we hope you enjoy it. This is also a chapter where supporting characters like Zhou Hanzhe and Yan shine, especially Zhou Hanzhe, and many of our group mates have changed their minds about how handsome Zhou Hanzhe is after reading this thread.
But after all, it was also goo goo goo for a long time, so I still have to apologize to everyone, but thankfully it's still out.
As for the subsequent updates, there is actually only one Xiao Yue amnesia line, and if you like this line after the Zi Shi update, we will also try to finish the Xiao Yue amnesia line to bring it to you.
So, happy new year everyone!

                                                                                                               StarWish Studio

"ShiErKe" is a romantic suspense game that combines text AVG and action deduction.
In an abandoned resort, with a dozen people with evil intentions to engage in a verbal encounter, whether you like to deduce and solve puzzles or raid characters, you can find their own fun here.
You can choose to take on the role of a detective and unravel the truth about this resort and have a real-life script kill!

So, detectives, are you ready?

notes.title: Sorry, we are going to reduce the price!!!!
notes.notes:
All the players who have supported us are really sorry. We will reduce the price.
It has been five days since Memories under the Blue Moon went on sale, and our mood has changed from the initial expectation to the present regret.
This is the evening of the fifth day. You can see that there are only 5 player comments.
Now I don't ask for anything. I just hope that more people can play this game. After all, it is also a hard work that we have insisted on for several years.
We also have no way. If we don't do this, we will only see dozens of sales in the background. We really don't know what to do next.
If more people can play, more people can see and discuss our works, maybe we have the motivation to continue to update.
We also discussed whether to reduce it slightly, for example, to 20 or 30, but we have missed the game of three days of gold,
It is impossible to attract people to visit just by a common price reduction, and it may also be considered that we want to make money.
So we decided to reduce the price to 10 yuan, with a discount of only a few yuan, which is almost the price of free play.
As for why it is not directly free, because the share of steam is deducted from this price, the rest of the money will be used to complete some follow-up work, such as remote dubbing or Li Zixi line.
As for everyone in our production team, it is still the same sentence. It may be the best incentive for us now that someone can play our game.
Finally, thank you very much for the players who bought our games at a high price. We will always remember your support.
Players who once bought at a high price can privately chat with the official exchange group to get 3 game codes for free, and we will refund the price difference when showing the screenshots.
However, the steam settlement cycle is one month, so we will record it first and refund the difference after one month. I'm really sorry for this.
But we are also very helpless, because we really can't afford to refund the difference at present,
If there are players who are willing to support us, we can also take out the activation code of the Oriental Illusion Record or the Twelve Scale Monthly Hour Meter, or some surrounding areas as money substitutes.
Finally, if you are willing, we hope to help us spread and meet our little wish that more people play our game.
Thank you very much (bowing -)

notes.title: SAPPHIRE MOON-FOREVER MEMORIES On sale now!
notes.notes:
HI, all players, after our active communication, "SAPPHIRE MOON-FOREVER MEMORIES" finally passed the STEAM review, will be on sale on September 24!

On the occasion of the shelves, the following questions we do a unified answer.

[b]Why only part of the dubbing? [/b]

Due to the epidemic, some of the voice teacher's recording changed to online recording, so there is a certain delay, our dubbing currently installed all the main characters of the dubbing, including the night Qiao Yue, Cheng Chen, Wan Zixi, Lin Ling, thank you for all the CV's dedication to voice ~.

[b]What will follow? [/b]

In the first week, we will update the dubbing of Samuel and some of the supporting characters such as Yan, Zhou Hanzhe, Xiao Xiao, and Lin Yuanshan.

[b]What will be the next update? [/b]

We will update the free content in 1-3 weeks. The story of Zixi, a lonely girl, who, with your help, is able to overcome the darkness of Hanging City and become the King of Hanging.

We will then update the Night Qiao Yue DLC content, including a night Qiao Yue misunderstanding line and a night tour of Shantang Street mini-theater.








                                                                                                                                        2022年9月21日
                                                                                                                                                星愿制作组
